rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for chasing or following someone urgently.

example.jyutping: faai3 di1 zeoi1 zyu6 go2 go3 caak6

rows.note: Use this for actively seeking an objective, achievement, relationship, or dream.

example.english: I continue to pursue my dream.
example.traditional: 我一直追求自己嘅夢想。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 zeoi1 kau4 zi6 gei2 ge3 mung6 soeng2

rows.note: Use this when pursuing a profession, trade, business, or regular activity.

example.english: After graduation, I want to pursue a career in accounting.
example.jyutping: bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 soeng2 zou6 wui2 gai3

rows.note: Use this when pressing or urging someone to act or finish something.

example.english: The boss had to pursue me about the report until I finally submitted it.
example.traditional: 老闆催我交份報告，催到我終於交咗。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 ceoi1 ngo5 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ceoi1 dou3 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 gaau1 zo2
